repo_root.description: Absolute path, for the reasoning loop's context only — the harness independently enforces the repo-root jail on every tool call and never trusts this value for that purpose.

history.description: Prior exchanges from an interactive chat session, oldest first, so a follow-up like 'fix that' has context. Optional; absent for one-shot runs.

fast.description: Ask the model to skip extended 'thinking' for faster replies (less careful on hard multi-step work). Optional; default off.
